originalSourceObject.name: Alert

originalSourceObject.effect: +5 bonus to initiative, can't be surprised while conscious, creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls from being hidden

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Add+5 to actual new initiative rolls. While conscious, surprise imposes none of its action/movement/reaction restrictions on you; retain any underlying first-turn schedule and all unrelated incapacity, without granting lost actions. Creatures do not gain attack advantage against you solely because their position is Hidden from you. NEW this prevents the unseen-attacker advantage when its sole cause is that specific Hidden state, but does not remove independent darkness/Blinded/Invisible or another source of advantage. It does not locate them, reveal a suspected square, grant sight or end their Hidden record for others. Other feat initiative bonuses may add by the proposed distinct-family rule. No initiative reroll, extra Reaction, or current-combat order change.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Exact Hidden-versus-independent-unseen distinction and conscious surprise suppression.
submittedWorkedCases: A hidden sniper gains no advantage from being Hidden from Alert; the victim still does not know the sniper's square before the shot reveals it normally.
Alert+Alertness adds7 to a new initiative roll. Becoming conscious later restores surprise protection but supplies no retroactive turn.

sourceObject.name: Ambidexterity
sourceObject.description: You can use both hands with equal skill.
sourceObject.effect: You can fight with two weapons without penalty to either hand.

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: Specify the actual two-weapon penalties waived under the current combat/equipment rules. Do not infer free offhand attacks, extra Bonus Actions, heavy/non-light eligibility, extra hands or damage-modifier grants absent a decision. Reconcile Dual Wielder and genuine physical wielding requirements.

sourceDirection.name: Ambidexterity
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Specify the actual two-weapon penalties waived under the current combat/equipment rules. Do not infer free offhand attacks, extra Bonus Actions, heavy/non-light eligibility, extra hands or damage-modifier grants absent a decision. originalSourceObject.name: Ambidexterity
originalSourceObject.description: You can use both hands with equal skill.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can fight with two weapons without penalty to either hand.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: The current ordinary two-weapon rule has no inherent attack-roll penalty for either hand; retain that absence. NEW completion of without penalty: when you make the ordinary two-weapon Bonus Action attack, add your usual positive ability modifier to its damage instead of omitting it. A negative modifier still applies normally. This specific grant can also restore the positive modifier to Double Tap's BA attack only if that attack is actually the ordinary two-weapon attack under both sources; a lone-crossbow Double Tap is not. The normal Light one-handed melee weapons, two usable hands, Attack Action trigger and real BA still apply unless Dual Wielder independently expands Light eligibility. It waives no proficiency, Heavy, anatomy, injury or improvised penalty and grants no second BA.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Explicit positive two-weapon damage-modifier restoration as the only newly waived hand penalty.
submittedWorkedCases: DEX+3 dual-Light ordinary BA attack adds3 damage with this feat.
Wielding two non-Light weapons still requires Dual Wielder; this feat alone does not authorize that pair.

completeSelectedRecords.name: Animal Companion

sourceObject.name: Animal Companion
sourceObject.description: You have formed a bond with an animal.
sourceObject.effect: You gain an animal companion that follows your commands and fights alongside you.

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: Complete a finite legal animal profile/selection and acquisition route, number, size/level progression, actual bond/ownership and command economy. Define initiative/actions/reactions, no-command behavior, injury/death/replacement and global creature caps. Existing Ranger companion rules are comparison evidence, not automatic Ranger class access.

sourceDirection.name: Animal Companion
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Complete a finite legal animal profile/selection and acquisition route, number, size/level progression, actual bond/ownership and command economy. Define initiative/actions/reactions, no-command behavior, injury/death/replacement and global creature caps. Existing Ranger companion rules are comparison evidence, not automatic Ranger class access.

originalSourceObject.name: Animal Companion
originalSourceObject.description: You have formed a bond with an animal.
originalSourceObject.effect: You gain an animal companion that follows your commands and fights alongside you.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW acquisition: with actual Animal Handling proficiency, select one already real willing/tamed Beast, noncorrupted, INT<7, that fits one of the three finite body templates below. Finding, buying or taming it requires actual campaign access/consent; the feat creates no animal, stocked shop or universal charm. Spend one uninterrupted hour together at touch range; one bond attempt per completedLR, noRP. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. AC12+floor(ownerPB/2), maximumHP5+total owner level; template attack/ability/movement values are explicit NEW. At initial bond convert existing HP proportionally max(1,floor(newMax×oldHP/oldMax)); preserve actual conditions/injuries. Later maximum growth never heals, decreases clamp without damage. Ordinary legal healing works, but no Hit Dice/rest-refill is invented. Use one shared BA command within60ft while the animal can perceive you: in its attached phase after your regular turn, move and make its one attack or Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. Death/release never creates replacement: after a new completedLR, a new real animal and full hour are required. Voluntary release takes one uninterrupted hour and ends the bond without healing; preserve the same physical animal and restore its prior ordinary profile with the same current-HP fraction, not a fresh full animal. A creature cannot have this and a Ranger bond simultaneously; transferring requires actual release and new paid acquisition, not additive statistics. Owner death ends the bond and, if the animal remains alive, restores its saved ordinary profile using the same positive-HP ratio conversion as release; a dead animal remains its actual corpse. Temporary owner incapacity prevents new commands but does not cancel a previously committed legal command; after that command, uncommanded phases remain defensive. This never supplies autonomous attacks.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Complete real-animal bond, three body templates, finite statistics, proportional conversion, command/HP-only death and no-free-replacement procedure.
submittedWorkedCases: A ground companion bonded by level5 has max10HP. A real animal at half of its oldHP converts to5HP, not full10.
At0HP it dies and leaves its actual body. Taking a rest alone neither revives it nor creates another beast.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt the bounded proposal with the completed EX58 controller/phase/physical-history interface; no future transport dependency or extra animal turn.

completeSelectedRecords.operationalRules:
NEW ACQ-05 purchase/bond distinction: acquire Animal Companion once by committing one actual earned unspent feat opportunity while meeting its actual Animal Handling proficiency prerequisite and all other acquisition gates. Record that paid grant and its acquisition snapshot atomically. The animal and bonding hour are not conditions of purchasing the feat. Ownership begins at that commitment, with no companion and one unspent bond attempt under FS-06; it grants neither an animal nor an earlier completed Long Rest. Animal identity, matching template and any actually sourced sense choice belong to each bond record, not a permanently locked feat-purchase choice. The retained nonrepeatability/permanent-choice metadata does not prohibit the replacements expressly allowed here. Canceling a proposed purchase before commitment spends no opportunity. A completed purchase is not refunded or repeated because no animal is available, a bond attempt fails, or a bond later ends. Animal Companion ownership alone can satisfy Companion Training's printed parent alternative, but supplies neither its separate feat opportunity nor a creature on which to use it.

NEW ACQ-05 bond attempt: an owner of this feat with actual Animal Handling proficiency, no current feat bond, no other pending bond attempt, an unspent attempt and any required post-bond-ending Long Rest may select one already real, positive-HP living, willing/tamed, noncorrupted Beast with INT<7 fitting one of the three finite templates. The selected animal must have no incompatible existing bond, including another Animal Companion or Ranger bond. Finding, buying or taming it still needs actual lawful access and its real willing/tamed relationship to this owner; no animal, stocked shop, consent or charm is supplied. Preserve its actual identity, ordinary profile, current/maximum HP, conditions, injuries, native movement, breathing, custody and required template choices. In one ordered start event, recheck admission, reserve this owner and animal for the work, spend the one attempt, and begin the hour. Merely proposing a target or rejecting it before that event does not spend an attempt; it never reverses a previously completed feat purchase. Starting costs no RP, second feat opportunity or universal fee. An attempt cannot begin while an existing feat bond is retained; such a rejected proposal does not release or alter that bond.

Spend one uninterrupted hour of actual bonding work together at touch range. Keep the same owner and animal, actual access, the required proficiency and animal eligibility throughout the work and at completion; the owner must remain able to perform it. This is active work, not beneficial rest, and grants no extra work Watch, assistant shortcut, handover or overlapping incompatible task. Loss of required touch-range access, willing/tamed eligibility, qualifying body state, or the owner's ability to continue, including incapacitation, or voluntary abandonment terminates the attempt. Elapsed time, real losses and the spent attempt persist; no partial hour, resumed fraction or same-epoch retry is awarded. The prospective animal remains in its actual current ordinary state; no feat profile or command entitlement was installed. After a full lawful hour, atomically complete the one bond and apply the existing template/HP conversion to the animal's latest lawful ordinary state, using the owner's then-current governing statistics. No new bond check or success chance is added. Admission alone or an incomplete hour cannot establish a companion.

The initial allowance is one attempt at feat purchase. Each genuinely completed beneficial owner Long Rest thereafter sets the allowance to one, never adds a stored second attempt. Apply FS-06's actual rest limits and one elapsed clock: no reset from Short Rest, debt-only Rest, a repeated rest receipt, a scene, a new target, a new controller, a new day label or level growth. Do not credit active bonding or release work as rest. An invalid claimed completion record is evidence rejection, not an attempt or feat-payment refund: reconcile the real start/interruption/rest history. Missing history cannot be replaced by an assumed unspent allowance. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. NEW ACQ-05 replacement boundary: when an established feat bond ends through release or death, record that actual ending event. Before this owner begins any later feat bond, require a genuinely beneficial owner Long Rest whose completion is ordered after that event, as well as an available attempt, a real eligible living target and the full new hour. A rest completed before the ending event or an unused prior allowance cannot satisfy that replacement gate. A qualifying completion after the event is sufficient; no additional rule requires the whole rest to have started after it. Existing active-work/rest restrictions still apply. Replacement is a use of the already-owned nonrepeatable feat, not a second purchase. NEW explicit rebond interpretation: a previously released living animal may be selected again if it genuinely qualifies; it is a new bond to the same physical individual, not a new or refreshed animal. A dead animal never becomes eligible merely through rest, release, purchase or this procedure. Voluntary release requires the owner's one uninterrupted hour of actual release work. NEW ACQ-05 release boundary: record its start, but end the bond only on lawful completion; interruption or abandonment grants no partial-hour credit and leaves the existing bond intact unless an independent event already ended it. A fresh release hour may be begun while the bond still exists. Release consumes no bond attempt, feat opportunity or RP. It does not require a second target or borrow the bonding hour's touch-range requirement; actual owner capacity and uninterrupted work remain mandatory. At completion restore the same living animal's saved ordinary profile with the existing positive-current-HP ratio conversion, preserving its current conditions, injuries and actual custody without healing or refilling it. End the outgoing bond's control entitlement and unexecuted commands; preserve all already-spent body/actor allowances. No automatic transfer of custody or command occurs. An existing Animal Companion feat owner does not buy that nonrepeatable feat again; they spend their own available attempt and full hour and satisfy their own post-ending Long-Rest gate, if any. The sender's rest, feat ownership or spent attempt neither transfers nor resets the receiver's history. A receiver without this feat must first acquire it through their own actual eligible unspent opportunity, or use an independently acquired receiving engine; receiving the animal grants no feat or class feature. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While legally riding a real mount under actual mounted/control/custody rules, your attacks have advantage against actual unmounted creatures. sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Literal broad attack advantage, current real mount, existing-mode+10 and no passenger stacking.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW once on your own turn, after your direct melee attack reduces a meaningful hostile from positiveHP to0, you may make one immediate additional melee weapon, natural or unarmed attack against a different creature within the actual reach of the selected legal attack. Death is unnecessary; an actually prevented drop gives no trigger. A different second target need not be hostile, but no staged friendly drop can generate the first trigger. Use current weapon/hands and normal attack/damage; no free draw. If multiple extra-attack sources trigger on the same drop, NEW choose one grant for that event, pay its actual cost, and do not bank the others.

originalSourceObject.name: Combat Casting
originalSourceObject.description: You have learned to cast spells in the heat of battle.
originalSourceObject.effect: Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration, can cast spells as opportunity attacks

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on CON saves specifically to maintain actual spell concentration, including concentration holding a readied spell. Other CON saves, nonspell concentration and generic Strain/Wounds gain nothing. War Caster's same advantage does not add another die; actual disadvantage cancels normally. When an actual opportunity-attack trigger would let you spend Reaction against one creature, you may instead cast one legally available Action-time spell whose actual target selection is exactly that creature. NEW any accessible rank is permitted, with no other creature/object target, area, self-only effect, long casting time, BA or Reaction spell. Recheck spell range/line/perception at the opportunity window; original movement-trigger timing remains before exit. The spell retains its own attack/save, actual casting route/rank/RP or charge, components/hands/focus, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and cast interruption. The spell resolves instead of the weapon attack and spends the same Reaction; no spell knowledge or cost waiver. For Sentinel and Battle Awareness it is a spell substitution, not an actual opportunity attack hit, so those weapon-attack event benefits do not automatically transfer.

An area burst or Self spell cannot qualify merely because only one enemy would be affected; neither can a1minute ritual.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW once during your regular own turn, before your first attack roll that turn, declare the−1attack/+1AC trade. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW once per turn, after your direct attack with a weapon whose native damage includes bludgeoning hits, you may move the target5ft to a legal unoccupied destination, subject to a target size no more than one category larger than you. A real natural weapon qualifies only if its profile is a bludgeoning weapon; ordinary unarmed is not one without an express rule.

originalSourceObject.name: Deadly Aim
originalSourceObject.description: You can trade accuracy for damage with ranged weapons.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Before any actual ranged attack roll, optionally accept−1 on that one roll to add+2flat damage if it hits. NEW the source says ranged attacks, so this includes ranged weapon, thrown, natural and spell attacks, but not save-only effects. The+2 joins one native damage component of that attack, chosen if multiple types, and is not doubled by a critical. It does not create damage for an attack with no native damage. Each attack makes its own pre-roll choice, no persistent stance or rest limit. Duplicate same feat cannot scale the trade; no retroactive selection after the die. Independently eligible feat modifiers may add unless their actual family forbids it.

completeSelectedRecords.name: Defender

sourceObject.name: Defender
sourceObject.description: You excel at protecting others.
sourceObject.effect: When an ally within 5 feet is attacked, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: Define Reaction declaration before the attack result, eligible attacker/ally sensing and physical restrictions if any, and exact5ft ally range snapshot. Apply disadvantage to that one attack, not an entire multiattack; no damage interception, movement, extra Reaction or negation of all advantage.

sourceDirection.name: Defender
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define Reaction declaration before the attack result, eligible attacker/ally sensing and physical restrictions if any, and exact5ft ally range snapshot. Apply disadvantage to that one attack, not an entire multiattack; no damage interception, movement, extra Reaction or negation of all advantage.

originalSourceObject.name: Defender
originalSourceObject.description: You excel at protecting others.
originalSourceObject.effect: When an ally within 5 feet is attacked, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When another allied creature within5ft of you is targeted by an attack, spend Reaction before its attack roll to impose disadvantage on that one roll. NEW you must perceive the ally and the attacker's actual attack; no can-see requirement, shield or free hand is added, but you must be capable of a deliberate physical distraction/intervention with line of effect to the ally. It does not require reaching the attacker, so a visible incoming ranged shot can qualify. Range is checked at declaration and no movement is granted. Advantage cancels normally; later attacks in a multiattack need their own actual triggers/resources. This grants no damage transfer, interception, AC bonus or reroll after the result.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Pre-roll Reaction, actual perceived attack/ally and interposition line without unprinted equipment tax.
submittedWorkedCases: An adjacent ally faces a visible archer's shot: spend Reaction before the roll for disadvantage.
A second attack in the same multiattack is unaffected unless a separate legal Reaction is available on that distinct event.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep actual source ally wording including self, with original target/sensory/budget conditions; no generalized automatic self-target for inherently two-person effects.

completeSelectedRecords.name: Disarm

sourceObject.name: Disarm
sourceObject.description: You can disarm opponents in combat.
sourceObject.effect: You can attempt to disarm an opponent as an attack. The target makes a Strength or Dexterity save (DC 8 + proficiency + ability modifier).

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: Preserve an attack replacement and target STRorDEX save against8+PB+ability modifier. Define whose choice, attacking ability, reach/weapon/hands, target-size/item constraints and failed-save item landing/custody. No automatic theft, destruction, disarm of implanted body parts or free replacement attack.

sourceDirection.name: Disarm
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Preserve an attack replacement and target STRorDEX save against8+PB+ability modifier. Define whose choice, attacking ability, reach/weapon/hands, target-size/item constraints and failed-save item landing/custody. No automatic theft, destruction, disarm of implanted body parts or free replacement attack.

originalSourceObject.name: Disarm
originalSourceObject.description: You can disarm opponents in combat.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can attempt to disarm an opponent as an attack. The target makes a Strength or Dexterity save (DC 8 + proficiency + ability modifier).

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Replace one attack of your Attack Action with this attempt against a held reachable object of a creature in your current melee reach. NEW choose either an actually wielded melee weapon or a usable free grasping hand as the implement; use that weapon's actual attack ability orSTR for an unarmed attempt. Target choosesSTR orDEX save DC8+PB+that actual ability modifier. No attack roll, damage, critical or on-hit trigger. Failure drops one declared object to a legal adjacent unoccupied space you choose, otherwise its own space; success keeps it. No size limit is added by the source, but physical reach, graspability and real non-droppable bonds remain. Implanted body parts, worn armor and strapped shields are not freely held droppable objects. You do not gain custody automatically; retrieving costs normal interaction/time. No special proficiency requirement grants missing weapon PB on other attacks.

submittedWorkedCases: ADEX+3 proficient dagger implement atPB3 setsDC14; target chooses itsSTR orDEX save.
A failed save can drop a held wand, but cannot sever an implanted claw or instantly transfer ownership to the attacker.

sourceObject.name: Dual Wielder
sourceObject.description: You master fighting with two weapons.
sourceObject.effect: You can use two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons and gain +1 AC while wielding two weapons.

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: Define non-light two-weapon eligibility using actual one/two-handed, heavy and size properties; neither extra hands nor dual two-handed wielding is implied. Preserve +1AC while actually wielding two eligible weapons, selected formula/stacking and loss when dropping one. Compare Ambidexterity separately.

sourceDirection.name: Dual Wielder
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define non-light two-weapon eligibility using actual one/two-handed, heavy and size properties; neither extra hands nor dual two-handed wielding is implied. Preserve +1AC while actually wielding two eligible weapons, selected formula/stacking and loss when dropping one. Compare Ambidexterity separately.

originalSourceObject.name: Dual Wielder
originalSourceObject.description: You master fighting with two weapons.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can use two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons and gain +1 AC while wielding two weapons.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: For ordinary two-weapon fighting, each weapon may be a non-Light one-handed melee weapon that you can actually wield in its own usable hand. NEW Versatile works using its one-hand profile; Two-Handed cannot occupy one hand, and Heavy/size penalties still apply even if an unusual legal one-hand profile has Heavy. Do not dual-wield a weapon requiring two hands with another weapon absent an actual specific hand exception. Gain+1AC while actually wielding two such usable melee weapons, one in each of two hands; a Broken, stowed, dropped or anatomy-incompatible weapon cannot supply the bonus. No extra draw/stow, BA or positive offhand damage modifier: Ambidexterity or another explicit grant supplies that separately. The ordinary Attack Action and two-weapon BA trigger remain.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Actual one-handed melee pairing, Versatile one-hand profile and AC dependency.
submittedWorkedCases: Two usable longswords can form a legal pair, each using1d8 rather than its two-hand1d10.
Dropping one sword immediately ends+1AC. A greatsword held with one hand does not become a legal paired weapon.

sourceObject.name: Elven Accuracy
sourceObject.description: Your elven heritage grants supernatural accuracy.
sourceObject.effect: When you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice.

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: Preserve Elf or half-elf eligibility without inventing an absent half-elf ancestry alias. For an advantaged DEX/INT/WIS/CHA attack define optional reroll of one die, timing, must-use-new result, number of rerolls and advantage cancellation. No automatic third die on disadvantage, STR attacks or repeated same-die chains.

originalSourceObject.name: Elven Accuracy
originalSourceObject.description: Your elven heritage grants supernatural accuracy.
originalSourceObject.effect: When you have advantage on an attack roll using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require an actual Elf ancestry receipt or a genuine independently sourced half-elf receipt; do not create or alias an absent half-elf base. On an attack actually made with advantage usingDEX,INT,WIS orCHA, after seeing the two original d20s and before final hit/outcome declaration, you may reroll one chosen die once and must use its new face in that position. Then keep the higher of the two resulting dice. NEW at most one Elven Accuracy reroll per attack; it cannot reroll the same die again through this feature or create a third independent kept die. If any disadvantage cancels advantage, there is one ordinary die and this feature is ineligible. STR/CON attacks, saves and checks do not qualify. Keep actual natural-face provenance for criticals. Lucky's separate die replacement may affect this attack only under its own one-event procedure; no Elven reroll of that additional Lucky die.

Advantage canceled by disadvantage yields one d20, so Elven Accuracy cannot trigger.

sourceObject.name: Fast Talker
sourceObject.description: You can talk your way out of trouble.
sourceObject.effect: You can attempt to distract or confuse enemies with rapid speech, potentially causing them to lose their action.

completeSelectedRecords.originalQuestion: The source has no action, range, skill contest/save, duration or cadence for enemy action loss. Complete each with actual speech/language/hearing and hard-control guard. Distinguish conversation from combat action denial, define immunity/repeats and no automatic consent or unlimited stun-lock.

originalSourceObject.name: Fast Talker
originalSourceObject.description: You can talk your way out of trouble.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can attempt to distract or confuse enemies with rapid speech, potentially causing them to lose their action.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW complete combat procedure: Action, once per SR, choose one hostile creature within30ft that can hear your rapid speech and understands the language you actually speak. Spend the use at declaration; it makesWIS save DC8+PB+CHA. Failure prevents it taking an Action during its next future regular turn; movement, BA and Reaction are not otherwise removed, and an extra-Action grant cannot bypass that turn's denial. The source-character/target/encounter hard-denial guard applies jointly with class/spell/companion/other feat denial; a target already affected by your hard denial in this encounter cannot suffer this rider again. NEW hearing/language comprehension and a capacity to process speech are required; explicit immunity to this mental action-denial effect blocks it, but the feat does not automatically impose Charmed, Frightened or Stunned. It neither forces beliefs nor commands a particular act. Outside combat it can support an ordinary social attempt but does not automatically win agreement or impose a recurring lost-time penalty.

A foe unable to understand the speech is ineligible, and a previously denied target is protected by the shared encounter guard.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain Intimidation proficiency, not expertise if already proficient. NEW in combat spendBA to demoralize one hostile within30ft who perceives your audible or visible credible threat. Oppose your normal CHA Intimidation (STR only if an independently legal actual source permits that substitution) with targetWIS Insight. Higher wins, ties preserve state; no natural task shift. Success imposes disadvantage on its next attack roll before your next original regular start, consumed by that attack even if canceled or missed. One attempt per target per owner regular-turn interval; new successful applications refresh one family record, not a queue. No SR cap beyond realBA/cadence. Shared language is unnecessary for a plainly understood physical threat; an unperceivable or incomprehensible threat is ineligible. This is a distinct demoralization rider, not Frightened, forced loyalty, Charmed or whole-turn denial; immunity to fear alone does not automatically block it unless it expressly covers demoralization/intimidation.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW gain3luck points, initially full and restored to3 only on a completedLR; no overcap or conversion. On your own attack, ability/skill/tool check or save, after the initial d20 die/dice are visible but before the outcome and consequences are declared, spend at most1point to roll one additionald20. Choose either to keep the original dice unchanged or to replace one original die with the new face; then apply the roll's original normal/advantage/disadvantage selection over its original one/two positions. The added die is not a third freely best-kept die under disadvantage. Actual natural face is the final kept face; no source allows inventing an automatic result. It may affect an opposed check or death save because those are your checks/saves; it cannot reroll an enemy, a damage die, a flat result or a no-roll automatic failure. NEW one Lucky intervention per underlying roll event even if another rule later rerolls it. Resolve Elven Accuracy on initial eligible dice first, then Lucky; Elven Accuracy cannot reroll the added Lucky die. Other mandatory whole-roll replacements preserve their own order and consume the same event entitlement.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At acquisition record whether the character has an actual independent darkvision source. NEW if none, this feat grants60ft ordinary darkvision. If one exists, instead record a permanent+30ft extension to the current strongest operative independent darkvision range; that mode adds no vision when every underlying source is suppressed/absent. Preserve the acquisition mode when forms/sources later change; no repeated+30 from toggling forms, reacquisition or multiple base ranges. A60ft-grant mode and later independent120ft darkvision use the strongest base120, not180; extension mode on120 becomes150. Ordinary darkvision sees dim light as bright and darkness as dim within range, without color in darkness; eyes/anatomy and Blinded still matter. Magical darkness, total cover and explicit blockers remain unless a separate source defeats them. It is not blindsight or general invisibility detection.

NEW if Savage Attacker also applies, resolve its whole-pool choice first, then Piercer on one die of the kept pool; no return to a discarded pool. All source-specific reroll limits remain.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per turn when you roll damage for your actual melee weapon attack, after seeing that roll but before consequences, reroll the entire eligible native weapon-dice pool once and choose either the complete original total or complete new total. NEW eligible pool includes base weapon dice, their critical copies and expressly additional weapon dice from feats such as Draw Cut, Orcish Fury or Piercer; exclude separate spell/Smite/poison/elemental rider dice and flat modifiers. Preserve each die's native type and apply the chosen corresponding per-type totals, not a pooled total reassigned to a preferred type. Never mix the best die from each pool or reroll only unfavorable dice through this feature. Roll once for each original die identity in the chosen pool, not new attacks or damage events. Maximized/fixed numeric damage has no rolled pool to reroll. Resolve Savage Attacker before Piercer's one-die adjustment if both are used; after selecting a pool you cannot return to a discarded pool to optimize a later modifier. Own and off-turn regular-turn allowances follow the shared cadence.

sourceObject.effect: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell. You cannot be surprised while conscious. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on actualWIS Perception checks relying on working hearing or smell, without a passive±5 adjustment. While conscious, surprise restrictions are suppressed as in Alert, with no retroactive actions. When actually tracking a real trail, ignore penalties caused solely by difficult terrain; preserve absent evidence, concealment, age, weather and source-specific no-trace restrictions. NEW the moonlight/transformed clause qualifies both the+2initiative and howl: at the actual initiative roll, if physically illuminated by real existing moonlight or in an actual body-transforming form, add2. It does not establish an astronomical calendar, count a moon-themed spell as moonlight, or treat an illusion/disguise as body transformation. Once perSR while that predicate holds, on your own regular turn without an Action cost, audibly howl/roar and choose one actual creature you are currently tracking through a legal source or personally damaged during this encounter. Other allies within30ft who hear at the moment gain advantage on their next attack against that chosen creature before your next future regular end. NEW recipient list and target are fixed, no continuing range tether and no extra attack; one family entitlement per ally, consumed by its first eligible attack hit/miss/cancellation. The body must actually be able to howl or roar; articulated speech or a shared language is not required. Silence or an anatomy unable to make that sound prevents it. Conditions otherwise permit this brief free communication but do not grantActions. Tracking alone does not reveal a target's present location for an attack.

original.name: Measured Strike
original.activation: Within one actual weapon attack, before its attack roll
original.procedure: Roll the spentd6 and add it to that one attack roll. Choose before seeing the d20/outcome; natural1 still misses and no extra critical range is created. It adds no damage and supplies no attack, target permission or extra Action.
original.basis: NEW attack-check enhancement; not an imported Battle Master maneuver.

original.name: Driving Shove
original.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary Shove
original.cost: One superiorityd6 plus the replaced attack
original.procedure: Before both opposed rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to yourSTR Athletics total for that one ordinary Shove. Target choosesAthletics/Acrobatics; tie preserves state. Actual reach/one-size-larger cap applies; success still pushes5ft away OR Prone, never both solely from this maneuver. It adds no damage.
original.basis: NEW finite bonus on reviewed ordinary Shove; printed feat/class save-based Shoves are not this maneuver.

original.name: Disarming Feint
original.activation: Replace one Attack Action attack with ordinary opposed Disarm
original.procedure: Choose a reachable actually held droppable item and an ordinary legal Athletics or weapon-check Disarm. Before rolls, spend/roll thed6 and add it to your one opposed total; defender usesAthletics/Acrobatics, tie preserves state. Success uses the existing adjacent/own-space drop placement, not automatic custody. No damage, severed bond or proficiency grant. The save-based Disarm feat and Whip Control are separate procedures and do not acquire this bonus.
original.basis: NEW finite die on reviewed ordinary Disarm only.

original.name: Guarding Deflection
original.activation: Reaction when one direct damage event would damage you
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Reaction
original.procedure: After passive defenses but before tempHP, spend/roll1d6 to reduce that whole resolved event by its face, minimum0. Allocate across stable native component order. Attached conditions remain. No re-mitigation of transfer packets that forbid recipient mitigation, HP sacrifice, state assignment or direct death. It neither changes a hit to a miss nor qualifies as Riposte's successful Parry.
original.basis: NEW finite physical defense using current whole-event/damage-provenance interface.

original.name: Measured Advance
original.activation: Bonus Action on your own regular turn
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual BA
original.procedure: Spend/roll1d6, gaining a separate movement-cost budget of5×face feet resolved immediately. Use one already available movement mode with nonzeroSpeed, pay normal terrain/crawl/squeeze costs, respect legal endpoints and provoke ordinary opportunity attacks. No teleport, new movement mode, free Disengage, replenished ordinary movement or banked distance. Interrupted unspent distance is lost.
original.basis: NEW bounded movement procedure; no copied Soldier grant.

original.name: Rallying Signal
original.activation: Action under the ordinary Rally procedure
original.cost: One superiorityd6 and the actual Action
original.procedure: Choose one actual ally within30ft able to perceive the rally and one active source-qualifiedFrightened record. Before rolling the ordinaryCHA task check at its sourceDC (otherwise10), spend/roll thed6 and add its face to the total. Apply actual task degrees/natural shift; success ends only that selected record. NoHP/tempHP, loyalty, extra save, new ally turn or automatic cure of other fear records.
original.basis: NEW finite die on current reviewed Rally.

reviewFindings: All116 current outcomes and FA05/11/12 are consistent under the stated source predicates. Complete originals and seven current replacements coexist without treating superseded additive slows or ally-only wording as current.

Companion purchase, actual body admission, paid bonding attempt, interrupted work, beneficial post-end rest, release and replacement are separate operations. No animal, inventory, resurrection or HP restoration is granted by a rest or feat receipt.
One actual mount/companion body retains compatible elected EX58 phase and movement history. Two eligible level10 Help recipients do not grant two offensive actions or independent turns.
Blind Fight30, Blind Fighting10 and Improved Alertness10 are different location/effective-sight operations. Shared names and ranges do not imply can-see permission or merged sensing range.

Ordinary Reaction refresh and numbered-round extra token use separate clocks with a shared one-Reaction-per-trigger gate. Extra Actions, extra turns and repeated callbacks do not reset unspecified wallets.

Current FS04 uses strongest adverse Speed result from the same pre-control base. Final FS06 unqualified once-per-turn follows actual turns; explicitly regular interval and Savage Attacker exceptions retain their text.

Elven Accuracy replaces one initial position; Lucky preserves the original selection mode; Savage Attacker chooses a whole native pool; Piercer rerolls one retained eligible die and adds its critical die after doubling. These are not interchangeable three-die or face-picking mechanics.

SUP01 common companion rules, all three SUP02 templates and all six SUP03 maneuver procedures were read as dependencies. Full SUP04 is preserved, with explicit Mage/Wizard/Cleric three-row selection and finite-count checks; this is not semantic closure of all16 curricula or their spell payloads.

Current self-ally cases still require actual senses, paid actions and fixed or continuous recipient membership as individually specified. No second owner identity, universal hearing, loyalty effect or hidden-location disclosure follows.
remainingScope: After registration222 original positions and13 additional boundaries remain across magic_core, magic_extended and heritage_mutation. Whole parent335 acceptance, all finite-table/full-copy dependencies, acquisition evidence and joint submission remain pending.

Reference arithmetic and narrow finite-state projections are not a production engine, full scheduler, arbitrary body/vision geometry or authenticated campaign event. Actual eligibility and source predicates outside each fixture remain external.

The bestiary replacement remains actively generating at last observation; its interim source claims are not independently accepted. This review does not change bestiary type, CR, cosmology or sealed-content scope.
No runtime testing, human gameplay, numerical balance, whole-game or release approval.
